title.value: CoQA: A Conversational Question Answering Challenge
title.justification: The paper is titled "CoQA: A Conversational Question Answering Challenge," and the abstract introduces the CoQA dataset.
title.quote: We introduce CoQA, a novel dataset for building Conversational Question Answering systems.

analysis.description: The paper introduces the CoQA dataset, which is designed to build and evaluate Conversational Question Answering systems by providing a large set of conversational questions and answers across various domains.

type.justification: The paper describes an empirical study where the CoQA dataset is developed and evaluated on various models.
type.quote: We analyze CoQA in depth and show that conversational questions have challenging phenomena not present in existing reading comprehension datasets.

name.justification: The research focuses on Conversational Question Answering systems within the greater field of Natural Language Processing.
name.quote: For machines to assist in information gathering, it is therefore essential to enable them to answer conversational questions.

name.justification: The research primarily focuses on conversational agents and the challenges associated with understanding and answering conversational queries.
name.quote: We introduce CoQA, a novel dataset for building Conversational Question Answering systems.

name.justification: The core of the research is about question answering within the conversational context.
name.quote: We present CoQA as a challenge to the community at such URL.
